ValidationRule.description: Project 790, Req 4: closes the "Closed Won, no proposal" gap. Blocks Send To Order Management when no related Quote exists, for flows requiring a proposal (see Proposal_Approval_Required__c). Uses the existing Number_of_Proposals__c rollup.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Send To Order Management"), Proposal_Approval_Required__c, NOT(Exempt_From_Proposal_Approval__c), Primary_Proposal_Status__c <> "Approved" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This opportunity cannot be closed won without a proposal (Quote) on file. Create and submit a proposal for approval before closing this opportunity.
